description.value: The Peachland Community Centre is a municipal facility operated by the District of Peachland, featuring a large main hall seating over 500 and a banquet room for 118, plus a commercial kitchen and stage. It sits along the Okanagan Lake corridor and offers shower facilities, which could be of interest to touring cyclists passing through the small lakeside community of Peachland.

provenance.category_correction_reason: A municipal community centre used primarily as a rental venue is not a conventional attraction; it may be better categorized as a civic/community resource, but no closer WWC category is evident.

judgement.verdict_reason: policy: rental/banquet hall, no walk-in public offering

Showers (drop-in or fee).detail: Shower facilities listed under Facility Features on the community centre page; unclear whether available on a drop-in basis or only for renters

wow_evidence: Rental hall with banquet rooms (KW-PRIVATE); showers noted but no walk-in offering.
blurb: Peachland's municipal hall and banquet facility on the lake corridor.
